extracted.intended_audience: researchers, patent practitioners, historians, and librarians who need an alphabetical index of U.S. patents (USPTO Annual Report 1878).
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index page from the 1878 United States Patent Office annual listing showing invention titles, patentees, patent numbers, issue dates, and Gazette/volume references for locating full patent records. Useful for locating patents by title or patentee in the 1878 USPTO record.
